registration.baseline_definition: A is fixed64e1665 plus reviewed PR1 instrumentation, separately measured by overhead-registration.json; it is NOT the bare64e1665 distribution.
registration.single_change: Canonical model split reducing browser-only model initialization; identical PR1 trace instrumentation on A and B.
registration.trace_comparability_note: Both A and B require the same reviewed PR1 traces and use the identical frozen measurement harness. Separate instrumentation_overhead experiment quantifies trace-versus-bare64 cost; this optimization estimates split-versus-traced-baseline, not split-versus-bare64.

A.source_fingerprint_scope: B-source-runtime-inventory.json from prior overhead registration; traced unoptimized baseline, not bare64

B.source_revision: 64e1665 + PR1 instrumentation + PR2 canonical split working snapshot

execution_preconditions: DO_NOT_RUN until actual Pyodide bundle and browser correctness acceptance completed and independently reviewed
DO_NOT_RUN concurrently with overhead experiment or other browser/heavy CPU work
Require explicit parent authorization for the single optimization measurement window

device.requested_renderer: SwiftShader flags; no observed GPU identity claim

method: Fixed AB/BA/AB/BA/AB; one Chromium; ten sequential fresh contexts; no warm reload, extra hot Worker, retries or sample exclusion. Exact frozen production rAF predicate and real accepted edit; confirmation includes automation scheduling. Nearest-rank percentiles.
limits: Ten cold attempts only; hot150ms gate NOT_RUN by this harness; final original enforce required.
Fresh browser contexts do not clear OS cache or all shared process state.
Only synthetic localhost scene; real GLB, public network, Edge and Safari NOT_RUN.
Trace stages may overlap; use thread epochs and analyzer, never sum marginal percentiles.
No population statistical-significance claim. Source revision/fingerprint/lock declarations are pre-registered provenance; served distribution/core hashes and actual UI core are verified.

startup_analysis.note: Epochs equal timeOrigin+now. Parallel spans use interval union, never summed; residuals are not assigned to compilation/import/network. Edit-eligible is diagnostic, not the enforced actual DOM editable metric.
